_comment: v0.7 (adr-0009) routing golden set. Every entry's `source` says where it actually came from: 'test_suite' = a query string that literally appears in the v0.1-v0.6 test suite already exercising intent_router/graph/openstack_expert (i.e. a question someone actually typed while building/testing this system); 'router_prompt_example' = one of the worked examples already baked into intent_router.py's own _SYSTEM_PROMPT (adr-0007/adr-0008), which were themselves written from real routing confusions seen during that testing, paraphrased into a full question here; 'extrapolated' = a natural variation of the above, added only to round out coverage per agent, not a new invented category. Nothing here was invented from a blank page. `expected_target_agent` is what app.agents.intent_router.route() should set state['target_agent'] to -- 'clarify' is itself a valid, correct outcome (see intent_router.py's CLARIFY_THRESHOLD), not a failure to route.
